findings: The exact-form interface repair is not internally closed. The executable negative check l001-p2-negative-model-check-understanding uses focus asset bank-plate-01, visible mismatch spoon, options spoon/plate, and correct answer plate, but adaptive.runtime_contract.interface_checks.check-negative instead declares focus cup, visible mismatch plate, options spoon/cup, and correct answer cup; its declared mismatch is not even one of its own option_ids. The same runtime registry also invents affirmative option IDs cup-image/plate-image rather than the executable check-affirmative-cup/check-affirmative-plate IDs and binds the W and OR checks to cup although the executable checks use spoon and bowl. Freeze one authoritative interface-check contract whose asset, visible operand, option IDs, correct answer, response mode, and failure replay exactly match each emitted check.

The eight-versus-four count defect is repaired and the new pixels now show a genuine continuous goal-development-resolution event, but the matching-metadata contradiction remains. picture_book.instructional_kernel says the eight cards begin beside eight distinct matching positions and are moved into their matching positions, while the reviewed pages show eight visually generic empty slots and story_arc, page facts, resolution, and world metadata repeatedly state that no card-specific matching relation exists or is taught. Remove the unsupported matching claims or make the relation visibly true and prerequisite-safe; the current contract asserts mutually exclusive world facts.

The comprehension/transfer state contract is not executable as written. phases.execution_sequence places the worked story-interface item, its unscored check, six scored next-scene questions, and eight unseen photo transfers together in one 16-item comprehension block, but runtime_contract.state_machine leaves comprehension immediately after only the worked and unscored checks, then says transfer completes after eight checks. Its finish_predicate separately requires all 16 comprehension units and all 8 transfer checks, even though turn_accounting defines those eight direct transfers as part of the same 16 comprehension units. This both omits the six scored sequence events from an explicit transition and ambiguously double-counts the eight transfers. Define distinct reachable substates and one nonduplicated completion predicate matching the frozen execution sequence.

Budget and replay stopping rules remain incomplete and contradictory. The 352-unit maximum is exactly base 148 plus listed adaptive additions 56 plus replay 148, but maximum_adaptive_additions omits up to four presentation-check replay/recheck paths. REPLAY_LESSON preflight requires only one remaining tool call despite replaying a machine-control-heavy 148-unit base path, and the state machine exposes replay only from mixed_practice even though the release rule/controller table describe replay after a complete non-alarm aggregate failure, including failures that can occur at comprehension, transfer, or recap. Freeze exact teacher, student, and tool-call costs for every interface replay and intervention, identify the states from which replay is legal, and require a full preflight before any replay can start.
